# evroc_service_account_credential (Data Source)

Retrieves metadata for an existing RS256 JWT or HMAC-SigV4 service account credential. Private keys and HMAC secrets are only returned during creation and cannot be retrieved by this data source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "evroc_service_account_credential" "existing" {
  name                = "application-hmac"
  project             = "my-project"
  service_account_ref = "/iam/projects/my-project/serviceAccounts/application"
}

# Only metadata is available; this lookup cannot recover the secret.
output "access_key_id" {
  value = data.evroc_service_account_credential.existing.access_key_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the credential to look up.
- `service_account_ref` (String) Fully qualified ID of the parent service account.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project containing the credential. Defaults to the provider project; set it to match the project in service_account_ref.

### Read-Only

- `access_key_id` (String) Access key identifier for HMAC credentials.
- `access_token_lifetime` (Number) Access token lifetime in seconds for RS256 JWT credentials.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the credential was created (RFC3339 format).
- `credential_id` (String) System-assigned unique identifier (UUID) of the credential.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the credential's purpose.
- `expires_at` (String) Expiration timestamp for the credential (RFC3339 format).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `revoked_at` (String) Revocation timestamp in RFC3339 format, or empty if not revoked.
- `type` (String) Credential type: rs256-jwt or hmac-sigv4.
